gui.shincolle.book.chap0.text0d0:
§cShinkaiseikan§0 is a group of lovely ship girls born from iron and grudge, they originally live freely in the ocean.
But one day, a fleet called §9Kanmusu§0 appeared with horrible weapons and began to attack §cShinkaiseikan§0's habitat without reason.
gui.shincolle.book.chap0.text0d1:
Because of this vandalism, §cShinkaiseikan§0 is facing a serious survival crisis.
Only one person can lead the ladies out of despair, it is YOU... become an §4Abyssal Admiral§0 and save them from the crisis!
gui.shincolle.book.chap0.text1d0:
Explore the world and collect four resources: §dGrudge§0, §dAbyssium§0, §dGrudgeful Ammo§0 and §dPolymetal§0 to construct §cShinkaiseikan§0.
§cShinkaiseikan§0 will protect the owner and attack any hostile mobs with a sufficient supply of resources.
gui.shincolle.book.chap0.text1d1: Now go to collect these lovely ladies!
gui.shincolle.book.chap0.text2d0:
§1Additional information No.1 §0:
Did you know that you can right-click to skip 10 pages?
§1Additional Information No.2 §0:
?????
gui.shincolle.book.chap0.title: Introduction
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text0d0: §d§nGrudge§r§0 is the residue after mob death, it is also the energy source for §cShinkaiseikan§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text0d1:
Kill mobs to get §d§nGrudge§r§0, you can build a mob farm to stably produce §d§nGrudge§r§0.
Combine 9 §d§nGrudge§r§0 to get 1 §9Grudge Lump§0, and further combine to §9Heavy Grudge Lump§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text10d0: Offering the heaviest grudge and diamonds to pray for Abyssal Goddess's protection, §d§nThe Grudge of Abyssal Goddess§r§0 will protect the §cShinkaiseikan§0 from fatal damage and give her a will for revenge as deep as the abyss.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text10d1: Put §d§nThe Grudge of Abyssal Goddess§r§0 in the ship's inventory, it will be consumed when the ship takes fatal damage. The ship will recover to full HP and be immune to damage for a while.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text11d0: §d§nWo-Class Command Scepter§r§0 is the aircraft command equipment for magic girl Wo-Class. However the Abyssal Admiral cannot transform into a magical girl, the scepter can only be used by the Abyssal Admiral to command ships.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text11d1:
There are 3 command modes, store up to 9 teams, and each team 6 ships maximum.
§2Single Mode§0:
Only 1 §3Focus Target§0, command will ONLY apply to the §3Focus Target§0.
§4Group Mode§0:
0~6 §3Focus Target§0, command will ONLY apply to the §3Focus Target§0.
§6Formation Mode§0:
Ship move in specific formation and gain additional effect, the command will apply to ALL ships.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text12d0:
The color circle will appear when holding command scepter:
§2GREEN§0:
Ship in §2Single Mode§0.
§3CYAN§0:
Ship is §3Focus Target§0.
§4RED§0:
Ship in §4Group Mode§0.
§6YELLOW§0:
Ship in §6Formation Mode§0.
§7WHITE§0:
Guard target.
§9Left Click§0:
Add ship to the team / Add target to attackable list / Set focus target.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text12d1:
§9Sprint+Left Click§0:
Change formation.
§9Sneak+Left Click§0:
Remove team / Change command mode.
§9Sneak+Sprint+Left Click§0:
Clear team.
§9Right Click§0:
Move and guard / Attack / Sit / Caress.
§9Sprint+Right Click§0:
Guard target.
§9Sneak+Right Click§0:
Open ship's inventory / Formation GUI.
§9List Players:§0
Change to caress mode.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text13d0:
§9Formation§0:
Ships will move in formation at the same speed and gain formation buffs, you need 5 or 6 ships in a team to use formation mode.
If a ship is in formation mode, move/guard command in single/group mode will be disabled.
And if a ship exists in different teams, the formation buff will apply to only one team.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text13d1:
§2Line Ahead§0:
Artillery combat formation, increase firepower but reduces defence.
§3Double Line§0:
A cruising formation with slight firepower buff.
§4Diamond§0:
Defence formation for aerial combat.
§6Echelon§0:
Charge formation with high moving speed buff.
§7Line Abreast§0:
Defence formation for anti-submarine combat.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text14d0:
§d§nModel 21 Zero Fighter§r§0
Scale: 1/48
Made From: Polymetal
Serving Size: 2500g
Serving Per Container: 1
Shelf Life: §k100§r YR
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text14d1:
This model aircraft complies with Abyssal Edible Toys Standard, it's ZERO CALORIES, FUN, and TASTY!
This product contains rich polymetal, helps digestion and absorption of heavy metal, effectively promotes children's growth.
**AVOID SUNSHINE, HIGH TEMPERATURE AND HIGH OXYGEN.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text15d0: The §d§nAbyssal Logbook§r§0 contains detailed information of the abyssal resources, §cShinkaiseikan§0 and §9Kanmusu§0 found so far.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text16d0: The §d§nAbyssal Portable Radar§r§0 can detect nearby owned ships and remotely contact them or give orders.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text17d0:
This stable and durable §d§nAbyssal Admiral's Desk§r§0 is made of obsidian. In addition, to deal with official business, it can also block the gunfire from angry secretaryship.
**Please ask the secretaryship before purchasing the furniture.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text17d1:
§9Radar§0:
Show a list of nearby owned ships, and click ship on the list to carry out other action.
§9Abyssal Logbook§0:
Items, blocks and ships introduction.
§9Faction§0:
Create or add team with PVP mode.
§9Target List§0:
Browse attack target list.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text18d0:
Crafted from the choicest materials and lingering grudges, the §d§nAbyssal Admiral's Chair§r§0 offers comfort so deep, it refuses to let you go. The impact of the bombardment is absorbed right here.
**Please ask the secretaryship before purchasing the furniture.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text18d1: Both Abyssal Admiral and ships can sit.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text19d0:
§9Right Click:§0 Change Abyssal Waypoint stay time.
§9Sneak + Right Click:§0 pairing Abyssal Waypoint / Abyssal Crane and Chest.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text1d0: §d§nAbyssium§r§0 is a metal enchanted by grudge. It's the main material for building §cShinkaiseikan§0 and its equipment.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text1d1: Combine 1 Grudge and 1 Iron Ingot to get 1 §d§nAbyssium§r§0, 9 ingots can be combined to 1 §9Abyssium Block§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text20d0:
When the lava is compressed by heavy grudge, it will become §d§nAbyssal Volcano Block§r§0.
Decorative block.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text21d0:
When the lava is compressed by Abyssal Volcano Block, it will become §d§nAbyssal Volcano Core§r§0.
The core will consume grudge and spread the energy into the environment.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text21d1:
To active the core, place it §9nearby any liquid block and put some grudge§0.
§dEffect Area: width 13 / height 13 (down 6 / up 6) blocks§0.
If a ship is in liquid block within the effect area, she will restore HP and morale value.
The energy is said to maintain skin and beauty, and it's very popular among the Shinkaiseikan.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text22d0:
Twisted abyssal frame, decorative block.
It's a ladder block.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text23d0:
Waypoint block, a player can link waypoints by §dTarget Wrench§0.
If a ship moves to a waypoint, the ship will continue to move to next waypoint.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text23d1:
§9Right Click§0 with §dTarget Wrench§0 to show the waypoint info.
§9Sneak + Right Click§0 to link two waypoints.
A waypoint can save 1 NEXT and 1 LAST waypoint, and the max distance is 48 blocks.
If the waypoint links back to its last waypoint (next = last) when the ship moves to the waypoint, the ship will begin to move backward.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text24d0: The machine block for loading and unloading items to ship. The owner can link the §dAbyssal Crane§0 to §9any chest§0 or other §9Abyssal Waypoint§0 by §dTarget Wrench§0. The ship will start to load/unload items when she gets to the crane and go to the next waypoint after the job is done.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text24d1:
§9Top Left§0 button is §9Power Switch§0.
§9The Top Largest§0 button is §9Waiting Mode§0.
§9Middle§0 buttons with M/D/N are item matching condition.
§9Center 9x2 Slots§0 are loading/unloading targets, leaving them all empty means it will handle §9ANY§0 item.
Loading/Unloading can disable separately, and the ship will not attack and move while craning.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text25d0:
§9Right click§0 this book on ship will increase the ship level 5 ~ 10.
This book can be found in dungeon chest too.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text26d0:
A fluid container for ship fluid transport. There are 4 sizes of fluid containers.
Ships have to equip at least one §9Abyssal Pumps Station§0 to transfer fluid to the containers in the ship's inventory at Abyssal Crane.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text27d0:
§9Right click§0 to set recipe for ship's crafting task.
Please see chap.4 for more details.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text28d0:
§9Numpad 1:§0
§6ADD§r or §cREMOVE§0 entity in §dUnattackable Target List§0. §4(OP ONLY!!)§0
§9Numpad 2:§0
Show §dUnattackable Target List§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text28d1:
§dUnattackable Target§0 is immune to all ship's attacks, and can't be targeted. You can add entities like leash knot, item frame, cart, or boat.
This list applies to hostile mob ships too.
Ship, hostile ship and ship's summons can't be an unattackable target.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text29d0:
§9Enchant Shell§0 can be made in §cHadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0, and then craft with 8x the same potions to gain the potion effect.
Further, crafting with 8x the same potions can increase the effect chance and duration.
Crafting with different potions will replace the potion effect.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text2d0: §d§nPolymetal§r§0 mainly spawns in water-related biomes (ocean, river, beach). It's the main material for building §cShinkaiseikan§0 and its equipment.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text2d1:
This crunchy metal ball is one of an aircraft carrier's favorite snacks.
You can find lots §d§nPolymetallic Gravel§r§0 on the seabed.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text3d1:
In addition to iron, you can also use copper, gold, and diamond to make different quantities of ammo.
Replace §9Gunpowder§0 with §9Blazepowder§0 to make heavy ammo.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text4d0: §d§nRepair Bucket§r§0 is made from the most nutritious lava of the ocean and seasoned with a grudge, it's the most popular §cShinkaiseikan§0 drinks.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text4d1:
Right click on ship to repair the ship.
Ships can automatically use the §d§nRepair Bucket§r§0 in their inventory.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text5d0:
§d§nShinkaiseikan Wedding Ring§r
With the classic minimalist style of prong mount and Nether Star Cut, it generously showcases the light of Nether Star.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text5d1:
It symbolizes the beauty of the Nether and the owner's strength, and it's also an important sign of lasting love.
§9Sneaking+Right Click§0:
Marry the ship.
§9Right Click§0:
Activate the ring.
The number of married ships will activate different abilities: digging speed, vision, breathing, mobility in liquid, and immunity to fire.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text6d0: The §d§nShinkaiseikan Ownership Paper§r§0 details the terms for transferring ownership of items. It takes effect only after being signed by both parties.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text6d1:
§9Right Click§0:
Sign the paper.
After the signature of the parties, the owner can sneak + right-click the paper on the ship to transfer the ownership to another player.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text7d0: §d§nDismantle Hammer§r§0 can decompose the ship and recycle some of the material.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text7d1:
§9Left Click§0:
One shot kills the ship. (OWNER/OP ONLY)
§9Sneaking + Right Click§0:
Decompose the ship. (OWNER/OP ONLY)
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text8d0: §d§nModernization Toolkit§r§0 contains a variety of the latest abyssal black technology, can be used to upgrade the ship's attributes.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text8d1:
§9Right Click§0 on a ship to upgrade one of the ship's attributes randomly. The level of attributes is represented by color in ship's inventory GUI:
§7WHITE§0 (Lv1)
§eYELLOW§0 (Lv2)
§6ORANGE§0 (Lv3)
§4RED§0 (Lv4)
The maximum level is §4RED§0 (Lv4).
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text9d0: §d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 contains some rare materials and the welding gun which provides a temperature higher than geocentric, it can improve the construction speed of abyssal ships and equipment.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.text9d1:
Put the §d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 in §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 or §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 to increase the construction progress.
§d§nInstant Construction Material§r§0 can only be crafted from NOT USED ship construction items.
gui.shincolle.book.chap1.title: Resources
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text0d0: You can start building primary class §cShinkaiseikan§0 in the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 if you have collected enough resources.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text0d1: You need §916~64§0 §4Grudge / Abyssium Ingot / Polymetallic Nodules / Grudgeful Ammo§0 and a large amount of lava as power.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text1d0:
After putting resources into the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0, click the §4"Ship Spawn Egg"§0 icon on the right side to start building §cShinkaiseikan§0.
§9Double Click§0 the icon to enter a §cContinuously Build Mode§0, the amounts of four resources will be recorded and every construction will consume the recorded resources.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text1d1:
You can get a §9Ship Spawn Egg§0 when construction is completed, use the egg to create a random §cShinkaiseikan§0.
The spawn egg user will become the §cShinkaiseikan§0's owner.
The amounts of four resources will affect the kind of §cShinkaiseikan§0, ex: §dPolymetal§0 will §9increase§0 the prob of §dAircraft Carrier§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text2d0:
In general, the more materials consumed, the better Shinkaiseikan you get.
To §9Develop Equipments§0, click the §4"Cannon"§0 icon, the construction requirements are the same as for shipbuilding.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text2d1:
§cTips:§0
1. Put §9Instant Construction Material§0 into the fuel slot to speed up build progress.
2. Put §9EnderTank§4 (mod: EnderStorage)§0 into the fuel slot to refuel lava.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text3d0: When you have accumulated a lot of resources, you can try to build advanced class §cShinkaiseikan§0 in §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text3d1:
§9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 is a 3x3x3 multiblock building:
§cBottom Layer:§3 3x3 Polymetallic Block§0
§cMiddle Layer: §34 corners of Polymetallic Block§0
§cTop Layer: §3Heavy Grudge Lump§0
§9Right click§0 the §4Heavy Grudge Lump§0 to activate the vortex.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text4d0:
§9To construct advanced §cShinkaiseikan§0:
1. Put resources into the 9 slots.
2. Click the 4 resources icon and adjust the value by arrows.
3. Click §4"Ship Spawn Egg"§0 icon to start construction.
4. §9Double Click§0 to enter §4Continuously Build Mode§0.
NOTE: The leftmost slot cannot be extracted by hopper or pipe, and other slots can only be extracted when the red arrow is in §9Release§0 mode.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text4d1:
Click the §4Red Arrow§0 to change resources mode: §9Release§0 or §9Suck In§0.
The large construction requires §9100~1000§0 each resources and lots of lava to process.
And the more materials consumed, the better §cShinkaiseikan§0 you get.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text5d0: The equip development is the same with ship construction, put some materials in the §9Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent§0 or §9Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex§0 and click the Equip button to develop equips.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text5d1:
The equip info is described in the item tooltip:
Factor Mats:
The number represents the total amount of materials and the effective material.
Rare Level:
Higher the value means the more rare in that equip type.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text6d0:
Equips can be enchanted by an enchanted book and anvil to increase the stats. Enchanting costs a fixed 30 levels. There are 3 enchant types: §cWeapon§0, §9Armor§0 and §3Misc§0, some enchantment only works on specific types.
§9Protection:§0 +HP.
§9Sharpness, Smite, Bane, Power:§0 +damage, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Unbreaking:§0 +DEF, §3ARMOR§0 only.
§9Efficiency:§0 +reload speed.
§9Aqua Affinity, Feather Fall, Depth Strider:§0 +move speed.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.text6d1:
§9Knockback, Punch:§0 +range.
§9Frost Walker:§0 +critical.
§9Fire, Flame:§0 +double/triple hit.
§9Lure:§0 +miss reduction.
§9Thorns:§0 +AA.
§9Respiration:§0 +ASM.
§9Looting, Fortune, Luck:§0 +exp gain, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Silk Touch:§0 +grudge gain, §3NON-WEAPON§0 only.
§9Infinity:§0 +ammo gain, §cWEAPON§0 only.
§9Mending:§0 +HP recovery, §3NON-WEAPON§0 only.
gui.shincolle.book.chap2.title: Construction
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text0d0:
§91.§0 By construction.
§92.§0 Found in dungeon chest.
§93.§0 Defeating the spawned hostile ship.
The easiest way is to spend resources to build a ship, and you can find some advanced class ships and equipment in the dungeon chest.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text0d1:
If you have §dShinkaiseikan Wedding Ring§0 in inventory and in the §9Sea/Beach§0 biome, the hostile fleet may appear on the sea.
You can get a ship's spawn egg by defeating the spawned hostile ship.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text10d0:
There are restraint relations between ships, check: §9https://goo.gl/jmR3Wd§0
§9Destroyer (DD):§c HIGH speed / LOW HP§0, against SS and Aircraft.
§9Cruiser:§0 Including heavy cruiser (CA), light cruiser (CL) and torpedo cruiser (CLT), average attributes.
§9Aircraft Carrier (CV): §cLONGEST attack range§0, against all ships except SS.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text10d1:
§9Aviation Battleship (BBV):§0 Including BBV and Installation, attributes range between CV and BB. §dInstallation§0 has §cLOW firepower / HIGH HP§0.
§9Battleship (BB):§c LOW speed / HIGH HP and firepower§0, against all ship but SS and Aircraft.
§9Submarine (SS):§c LOW speed and HP / HIGH firepower§0, against all ship but Aircraft.
§9Aircraft:§0 Aircraft attack by CV and BBV, against all ship but SS.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text11d0:
Some Shinkaiseikan can summon mounts, it can be enabled in §9Appearance§0 page in §9AI Options§0.
§9Right-click§0 on a mount to ride it, then the owner can control mount movement and use attack skills.
§9Press move key§0 (default:WASD) and §9jump key§0 (default:SPACE) to control movement.
§9Press hotbar key 1~4§0 (default:1,2,3,4) to use attack skills.
Attack skills consume the ship's ammo and grudge, and the cooldown time is counted separately from the ship's attack skills.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text12d0:
Status effect can increase or decrease ship's attributes.
§9Speed:§0 +move speed
§cSlowness:§0 -move speed
§9Haste:§0 +attack speed
§cMining Fatigue:§0 -attack speed
§9Strength:§0 +damage
§cWeak:§0 -damage
§9Absorption:§0 +defence and HP
§cPoison:§0 -defence
§9Health Boost:§0 +HP and HP regen
§9Resistance:§0 -damage by torpedo
§9Fire-Resistance:§0 -damage by non-torpedo
§9Jump Boost:§0 +hit range
§cBlind:§0 -hit range greatly
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text12d1:
§cInstant Damage:§0 damage ship
§9Instant Heal:§0 heal ship
§cWither:§0 damage ship over time
§9Regeneration:§0 heal ship over time
§cNausea:§0 +miss rate greatly
§9Night Vision:§0 Negates the 80%% damage reduction penalty at night
§9Luck:§0 +critical/double/triple hit rate
§cBad Luck:§0 -critical/double/triple hit rate
§9Water Breathing:§0 +ASM and dodge rate
§9Levitation:§0 +AA and dodge rate
§cHunger:§0 +grudge consumption greatly
§9Saturation:§0 increase grudge and ammo gained, heal HP and increase morale over time
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text13d0:
The morale level will affect the ship's attributes and experience gain.
There are 5 levels of morale: §dExcited§0, §cHappy§0, §2Normal§0, §9Tired§0, §7Exhausted§0.
The morale level is marked in the upper right corner of ship's inventory GUI.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text13d1:
§9Idle:§0
Recover morale to §2NORMAL§0 state, out of combat faster than in combat.
§9Caress, Kill:§0
Increase morale to §dEXCITED§0 state.
§9Feeding:§0
Increase to §cHAPPY§0 state.
§9Moving, Attack, Damaged:§0
Decrease morale.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text14d0:
Generally a ship doesn't need to be fed, but you can feed the ship to increase morale and grudge value manually.
§9Right click§0 on ship with food or some items to feed the ship.
You can only feed a ship a certain times within a given period.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text14d1:
§9Grudge, Food:§0
Increase grudge, morale value.
§9Ammo:§0
Increase morale and ammo value a little more than automatically consumed by the ship.
§9Abyssium, Polymetal:§0
Increase number of aircraft for CV.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text15d0:
The owner can caress the ship to reward or simply harass her. A correct caress can §9improve the shop's morale§0 effectively.
To caress ship, hold §dWo-Class Command Scepter§0 and press §9List Players (default: TAB)§0 to change to caress mode, and §9Right Click§0 on the ship.
gui.shincolle.book.chap3.text15d1:

patchouli.shincolle.book.landing_text: Welcome back, admiral. This manual organizes ShinColle resources, equipment, systems, and common workflows. Start with the beginner and item entries first, then check the systems section. Migration-facing technical notes now live in their own category.

patchouli.shincolle.entry.commands.name: Commands
patchouli.shincolle.entry.commands.page0: Common migration-safe commands include $(thing)/shipinfo$(), $(thing)/shipupdateowneruid$(), and $(thing)/shipemotes$(). Use them for inspection, owner fixes, and expression testing.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.commands.page1: Operator-oriented commands such as $(thing)/shipchangeowner$(), $(thing)/shipcleardrop$(), and $(thing)/shipkill$() are intended for recovery or server maintenance. Prefer them over ad-hoc NBT edits.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.desk_and_radar: The Abyssal Admiral's Desk remains the central control block. Use it for radar recall, manual access, diplomacy and team management, and other base-side command actions.
Craft the desk early and keep one in base. It is the fixed hub for fleet administration, nearby ship listings, diplomacy, and opening the in-game manual.
Keep a portable radar on you when you want to inspect or recall nearby owned ships without returning to base. It complements the desk instead of replacing it.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.manual_tools.p: The $(item)Desk Book$() is now the main in-game encyclopedia for resources, equipment, systems, and workflows, while $(item)Recipe Paper$() assigns crafting jobs to ships. Implementation details and migration notes belong in the separate $(thing)Technical Notes$() entry.
Readable Documentation
$(item)Desk Book$() opens the scalable in-game manual. $(item)Recipe Paper$() stores a 3x3 ghost recipe and is meant to be placed in a ship's main hand slot for waypoint-based crafting automation.
Book and Recipe Paper
Craft the $(item)Desk Book$() early — it is your in-game encyclopedia. Use it alongside $(item)Recipe Paper$() once you start automating.
Desk Book Recipe
Recipe Paper belongs in a worker ship's main hand slot. It stores the single 3x3 ghost recipe that waypoint-based crafting jobs will follow.
Recipe Paper Recipe

$(item)Target Wrench$() links waypoints to chests and control blocks. The paired $(item)Portable Radar$() opens the nearby owned-ship list remotely, so both items now sit on the same utility page as their actual crafting recipes.
Target Wrench
The $(item)Target Wrench$() links waypoints to chests and machines. Craft the $(item)Portable Radar$() separately using the recipe below.
Target Wrench Recipe
Portable Radar is the lighter remote-control companion to the desk. Carry it when you need ship recall and list access while away from base.
Portable Radar Recipe

The $(item)Marriage Ring$() and $(item)Abyssal Admiral's Desk$() both use normal crafting now. The ring is a progression item for a single owned ship, while the desk remains the permanent hub for radar, factions, and the in-game manual.
Core Utility Recipes
The $(item)Marriage Ring$() is a permanent upgrade for one trusted flagship. It raises the level cap and unlocks aura abilities.
Marriage Ring Recipe
The desk is worth crafting even before deeper automation. It centralizes radar, diplomacy, ship management, and access to the manual.
Desk Recipe

$(item)Marriage Ring$() is used directly on a tamed owned ship. Married ships unlock higher level caps and additional ring-based effects, while the ring itself can be toggled for player-side aura abilities.
Marriage Ring
patchouli.shincolle.entry.automation_too: Waypoint-based automation is one of ShinColle's deeper systems. $(item)Target Wrench$() defines external block links, while $(item)Recipe Paper$() stores the ghost recipe that a working ship will follow.
Craft the wrench first, then place and configure an $(item)Abyssal Waypoint$(). The waypoint becomes the anchor for mining, smelting, fishing, and crafting routes once a ship is assigned to the task.

$(item)Recipe Paper$() holds one 3x3 ghost recipe. Put it into the worker ship's main hand slot, then make sure nearby inventories contain enough real materials for the target pattern. $(item)Abyssal Crane$() is the matching logistics block for loading and unloading those routes.

The three small checkboxes in the ship task page are recipe filters. $(thing)Check Metadata$() requires item damage or subtype to match, $(thing)Use Ore Dictionary / tag matching$() accepts equivalent tagged items, and $(thing)Check NBT$() also compares stored custom data. Turn on only the checks your route really needs, or older mixed inventories may stop matching.

The lettered side matrix controls where the worker reads or writes items. $(thing)Material Input$() is the source for crafting ingredients, $(thing)Output$() is the destination for crafted goods, and $(thing)Fuel$() is the source for furnace fuel. Each row maps to the six block faces: $(thing)B$() bottom, $(thing)T$() top, $(thing)N$() north, $(thing)S$() south, $(thing)W$() west, $(thing)E$() east. Purple means enabled, gray means disabled.

Use the crane when one adjacent inventory is not enough or when you need stable sided I/O. A common pattern is: waypoint near the ship, wrench links the waypoint to a chest or machine, then the crane side matrix decides which faces feed ingredients, receive products, or supply furnace fuel.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.automation_blo: $(item)Abyssal Waypoint$() is the routing hub for automated jobs. Nearby ships use it to determine where items should be pulled from, pushed to, or processed when carrying out mining and crafting duties.
$(item)Abyssal Crane$() handles block-side transfer support for heavier automation lines. Use it together with the waypoint when a job needs stable logistics instead of simple one-block adjacency.
$(item)Volcanic Core$() still marks the advanced volcanic and hadal branch. Both available recipes are listed here so the new manual can replace the missing old construction-book chapter.
Modern ShinColle still keeps the old fleet model: up to nine teams, each holding up to six ships. Use separate teams to split escorts, carriers, patrol groups, or reserve units before switching command modes.
The $(item)Wo-Class Command Scepter$() cycles between single-target, group, and formation modes. See $(thing)Fleet Control and Formations$() for the full controls guide.

Formation mode still expects five or six ships and applies formation-wide buffs. Line Ahead favors artillery, Double Line is a stable cruising layout, Diamond is the defensive anti-air choice, Echelon emphasizes mobility, and Line Abreast remains the anti-submarine pattern.

$(thing)Left-click$() on an owned ship adds her to the current team. If she is already in that team, she becomes the focus target instead.
$(thing)Sneak-left-click$() on an owned ship removes her from the current team.
$(thing)Left-click$() on a non-ship entity records that entity class as an attackable target.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.technical_note: This entry is intentionally separate from the gameplay tutorial. It tracks migration-facing notes for players who want to understand what changed between the legacy Forge branch and the NeoForge 1.21.1 implementation.

Fleet ownership, team selection, and several synchronized control states are now maintained through admiral data attachments instead of the old capability layer. The visible gameplay loop aims to stay familiar even though the persistence and sync implementation changed underneath.

Use this section for migration-specific behavior, compatibility notes, and system caveats. Core tutorials, crafting guides, and beginner explanations should stay in their own entries so the in-game manual remains readable during normal play.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.ship_care.name: Ship Care and Growth
patchouli.shincolle.entry.ship_care.page: Ships are not maintained only by raw stats. Morale, emergency repair items, marriage state, and direct training all affect how effective a ship stays over long deployments. The modern branch still keeps most of that old progression loop.

$(item)Repair Buckets$() restore HP directly and still grant extra aircraft recovery to carrier-type ships. $(item)Model 21 Zero Fighter$() is the lighter morale gift item and can also top up aircraft for carriers after use.

$(item)Marriage Ring$() is still the single-ship progression milestone. It upgrades the married ship's state, and the ring item itself can be toggled into an active aura that periodically boosts nearby owned ships into a happier emotional state. $(item)The Grudge of Abyssal Goddess$() stays as the emergency anti-sinking consumable.

$(item)Maintenance Personnel Training Book$() remains the direct level-growth consumable. Use it only on a tamed owned ship: it grants a random configured level increase, so it is more valuable on long-term core fleet members than on disposable early ships.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.ship_status.pa: Ships still follow the legacy class split: destroyers emphasize speed, cruisers are generalists, carriers lean into range and aircraft, battleships trade mobility for HP and firepower, submarines specialize in torpedo output, and aircraft/installation-type units occupy their own matchup niche.

Potion and status effects still modify ship attributes directly. Speed, haste, strength, absorption, resistance, regeneration, luck, water breathing, and similar effects can all improve combat performance, while slowness, weakness, poison, blindness, wither, and bad luck remain meaningful penalties.

Morale is still one of the most important hidden combat multipliers. Excited and Happy ships gain stronger offensive and utility scaling, while Tired and Exhausted states drag down effectiveness. The modern ship inventory screen still exposes morale state and the legacy morale-derived bonus table.

Some ships can still use mount-style support through appearance and AI toggles. When a mount-capable ship enables that option, the owner can ride the summon and access movement or attack skills through the mount flow instead of treating it like a normal passive visual part.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.logistics_and_: ShinColle's late-base loop is not just about combat. Dense grudge storage, volcanic healing, waypoint routing, crane transfer rules, and ship tank capacity all work together once you start running a real port instead of a single-ship outpost.

$(item)Grudge$() can still be compressed upward into $(item)Grudge Lump$() and then $(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$(). Those heavier blocks matter because they are the practical storage tier for advanced construction and hadal infrastructure recipes.

$(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$() is the denser storage target once your port starts consuming large amounts of fuel. Use it for late-base stockpiles and recipes that would otherwise eat inventory space too quickly.

$(item)Volcanic Core$() consumes grudge fuel over time. When it is placed next to liquid, nearby owned ships in water are healed and gain morale; without nearby liquid, the same powered core turns into a dangerous heat source that burns ordinary living targets inside its area.
Keep both Volcanic Core recipes in mind when planning a base. The block pays off most when placed beside water so the same fuel consumption turns into healing and morale recovery for docked ships.

$(item)Abyssal Waypoint$() handles path routing, while $(item)Abyssal Crane$() handles the block-side transfer rules for loading and unloading. Together they let a working ship follow longer mining, smelting, fishing, and crafting routes instead of relying on direct adjacency.
The crane is the logistics-side filter block. Use it when you need stable loading and unloading, item matching rules, liquid transfer, or redstone-aware automation behavior around a waypoint route.

$(item)Ship Tanks$() remain the liquid-side extension for logistics fleets. The restored size variants scale from small field containers up to large hauling tanks, and they can interact directly with block fluid handlers or be used as ship-side transport inventory.
Larger ship tank variants are better suited for hauling and automated port work. Pick the small tank for field utility and the large tank when a route needs real fluid throughput.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.automation_job: Waypoint automation in ShinColle is job-driven rather than fully generic. A ship's AI option selects the task, while the waypoint, linked blocks, held tools, and inventory layout define whether that ship will cook, fish, mine, or craft.

$(item)Crafting Recipe$() is the key item for automated crafting. Put the stored recipe into the ship's main hand, clear the crafting rows in the ship inventory, move the ship onto an $(item)Abyssal Waypoint$(), and link that waypoint to a chest with $(item)Target Wrench$().

Cooking uses the furnace-side settings from the AI page together with a waypoint-linked furnace. Fishing only needs the correct AI mode, a rod in the main hand, and a deep enough pool. Mining uses the pickaxe route and pulls results from the world/biome context instead of visibly breaking blocks.

Ship level still matters for automation throughput. Less experienced ships are less efficient, crafting will spill items if linked storage is full, and cooking is intentionally imperfect enough that low-skill ships may still produce some junk output during automated work.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.equipment_weap: Legacy ship equipment is now fully represented as variant-based items instead of old metadata. The creative tab exposes all restored variants, and the tooltip panel reads directly from the migrated legacy stat table.

$(item)Cannons$() remain the main source of firepower, range, and anti-air substats. Early single and twin mounts are cheap general-use options, while the late fortress and triple/quad guns are shipyard-tier upgrades with higher material thresholds.

$(item)Torpedoes$() are the torpedo-focused branch, and several higher variants restore the old speed-tier behavior. Fast torpedo models are intended for destroyers, submarines, and any ship leaning into burst torpedo damage.

$(item)Shells and special ammo$() cover armor-piercing, anti-air, gravity, anti-gravity, enchant, and cluster effects. The old $(item)Enchant Shell$() glint has been restored, and legacy custom enchant payloads still trigger foil rendering.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.equipment_supp: Support equipment covers aircraft capacity, detection, anti-air interception, armor plating, catapults, compass navigation, flares, searchlights, turbines, and general fleet utility. These variants are important on carriers, aviation battleships, and escort ships that need flexible secondary stats.

$(item)Aircraft$() include torpedo bombers, fighters, dive bombers, reconnaissance planes, and late-game land-based models. Higher aviation variants trade mobility for large airpower, anti-air, and torpedo-airstrike gains.

$(item)Radar and sonar$() provide hit, range, anti-air, anti-submarine, and critical-rate support. Surface radars and FCS variants are broad combat upgrades, while sonar-heavy models are tuned for submarine hunting.

$(item)Machine guns, catapults, flares, compasses, and searchlights$() cover the hybrid support niche. They boost anti-air or aircraft launching and also restore old passive utility like chunk-loading, target illumination, and self-lighting behavior.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.equipment_spec: Several legacy items do not exist for raw combat stats alone. Storage drums, transport tanks, ration chains, turbines, and armor pieces change how long a ship can stay deployed and how much work it can finish before returning to base.
$(item)Drums$() expand inventory capacity and support pump-station transport. They serve as backup storage when no dedicated IC2 module is installed.

$(item)Ship Tanks$() now expose all restored variants in the creative tab. They are the dedicated liquid and transport-line storage upgrades for ships assigned to hauling or automation-heavy waypoint routes.

$(item)Combat Rations$() form a multi-step food branch with several upgraded variants. They act as a field sustain line for long sorties and let you prepare better ship-side supplies than raw materials alone.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.fleet_support_: Not every important item belongs in a shipyard or equipment slot. Several support tools define how you organize fleets, repair ships, assign ownership, modernize stats, and push newly obtained ships through early progression.

The $(item)Wo-Class Command Scepter$() is the portable fleet-control tool. It cycles between single-target, group, and formation modes. See the $(thing)Fleet Control and Formations$() entry for complete controls.
$(item)Model 21 Zero Fighter$() is worth crafting even outside carrier combat. It doubles as a morale gift and a small aircraft restock item for carrier-type ships after repeated sorties.

$(item)Repair Buckets$() are the quick field-heal consumable, and $(item)The Grudge of Abyssal Goddess$() remains the premium emergency protection item. The goddess item always keeps its foil effect and is still meant to prevent a ship from sinking to lethal damage.
$(item)The Grudge of Abyssal Goddess$() is the premium last-chance protection item. Save it for trusted flagships or difficult expeditions where a lethal mistake would be expensive to recover from.
Use goddess charms sparingly and rely on $(item)Repair Buckets$() for day-to-day sustain. Buckets handle routine recovery, while the goddess item is reserved for preventing actual sink events.

The scepter's right-click controls:
$(thing)Right-click on the ground$() or a friendly target: issues a guard / move-and-attack order.
$(thing)Right-click on a hostile target$(): issues an attack order.
$(thing)Sprint+right-click$(): move-only guard command (no attacking).
patchouli.shincolle.entry.shipyard_tools: $(item)Instant Construction Material$() is the modern fast-build item for both shipyards. $(item)Kaitai Hammer$() recycles unused spawn eggs into build accelerators, preserving the old progression loop.
This illustration shows the original construction workflow. The same information is available through the Patchouli entries and in-game crafting recipes.
Both small and large spawn-egg construction materials can be recycled into instant build consumables. Place them in the shipyard fuel slot to skip a chunk of build time immediately.
This higher-yield recycling recipe is the main late-game loop for stockpiling instant build materials. It keeps the old idea of turning spare spawn eggs into construction acceleration.
The $(item)Small Shipyard$() handles regular construction. Its dedicated fuel slot also accepts Instant Construction Material, so even early progression can skip long build timers.
$(item)Volcanic Core$() already has multiple crafting routes in the modern branch and still sits in the deeper progression line around fuel, healing, and late-game automation support.

When a construction job is already running, place $(item)Instant Construction Material$() into the shipyard fuel slot to consume it and immediately advance the timer. Both small and large shipyards support this shortcut.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.intro.name: Overview
patchouli.shincolle.entry.intro.page0.te: This manual is meant to get you into $(ship)ShinColle$() quickly: gather resources, build ships, organize fleets, and then expand into equipment, automation, and later progression systems. Learn the play loop first, then drill into the detailed entries you need.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.intro.page1.te: Treat this manual as your in-game wiki. The beginner section explains resources and early progression, the item section focuses on recipes and tool roles, and the systems section covers desk control, formations, waypoints, commands, and other advanced features.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.resources.name: Core Resources
patchouli.shincolle.entry.resources.page: Most ShinColle progression still revolves around $(item)Grudge$(), $(item)Abyss Metal$(), $(item)Ammo$(), and $(item)Polymetal$(). They feed construction, repairs, and many ship-side interactions.
The Four Main Materials

$(item)Grudge$() is still the first real fuel resource. The basic loop remains the same as legacy ShinColle: mob drops become grudge, nine grudge compress into a $(item)Grudge Lump$(), and nine lumps become a $(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$() for denser storage and later recipes.
Grudge
Compression recipes let you condense early fuel into storage-friendly blocks.
Grudge Compression Recipes
$(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$() is the storage form you eventually want in bulk. It is the denser stockpile tier for advanced construction and port infrastructure.
Heavy Grudge Compression

$(item)Abyss Metal$() and $(item)Polymetal$() cover heavier crafting paths. Abyss metal still starts from iron plus grudge, while polymetal can still be compacted into blocks for building, storage, and later construction chains.
Abyss Metal and Polymetal
These compact forms are the standard stockpile materials for midgame construction.
Metal Compression Recipes
$(item)Polymetal$() compression matters once you are building larger bases or feeding repeated construction chains. It is the more practical stockpile form for bulk storage.
Polymetal Compression

$(item)Grudgeful Ammo$() and $(item)Heavy Grudgeful Ammo$() can both be packed into container form for storage-heavy bases, logistics routes, or bulk transport with ship inventories and automation chains.
Ammo Compression
Container recipes are the dense-storage version for regular and heavy ammo.
Ammo Container Recipes
$(item)Heavy Grudgeful Ammo$() containers are better suited for large resupply stockpiles and automated routes that move expensive ammunition in bulk.
Heavy Ammo Containers

The reverse recipes matter just as much: ammo containers unpack back into nine rounds. That lets you carry dense stockpiles during construction or resupply, then expand them only when a ship or storage line needs loose ammunition.
Ammo Unpacking
Use these reverse recipes when a ship or machine needs loose rounds again.
Ammo Unpacking Recipes
Heavy ammo unpacking is the reverse step for bulk logistics. Keep the dense container form for transport, then expand it only where heavy rounds are actually consumed.
Heavy Ammo Unpacking

patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.name: Operator Tools
patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.page0: A few tools exist outside the normal equipment and shipyard slots. They modify ship stats, transfer ownership, or provide debugging controls for server operators.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.page1: Right-click an owned ship with the $(item)Modernization Kit$() to add a random attribute point. The kit is consumed on use. The ship's current modernization limit can be configured in the mod's config.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.page2: The $(item)Ownership Paper$() transfers a ship's owner UID. Use it when you need to reassign a ship between players or fix orphaned ownership data.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.page3: The $(item)OP Tool$() is an operator-only debugging item. It toggles hostile targeting exceptions for specific entity classes.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.op_tools.page4:
Numpad 1: Adds or removes the targeted entity type from the unattackable list.
Numpad 2: Shows the current unattackable entity list in chat.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.utility_blocks: Beyond functional machinery, several blocks exist for decoration, structural building, and special storage. All are fully craftable.
The $(item)Abyss Frame$() is a decorative building block. Use it for structural accents and themed construction.
The $(item)Abyssal Volcano Block$() is a decorative block with a volcanic aesthetic. It pairs well with $(item)Volcanic Cores$() for themed builds.
The $(item)Sublimated Grudge Lump$() is a compressed grudge variant with special storage properties. Its exact behavior depends on the mod configuration.

$(item)Polymetal Ore$() and $(item)Polymetal Gravel$() are the natural world generation sources of Polymetal. Mine them to obtain raw $(item)Abyss Polymetal$(). Polymetal Ore generates at higher depths; the gravel variant is found near water bodies.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.hadal_vortex.p:
The $(c)Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex$() is the upgraded version of the $(9)Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent$() — a 3×3×3 multiblock structure used for $(c)high-tier ship construction$() and $(c)equipment development$().
Compared to the basic Vent, the Vortex supports more advanced ship classes (Princess-class, Demon-class, etc.) and can handle much larger resource batches.

Build the Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex as follows:
$(l)Bottom Layer:$() 3×3 $(item)Polymetal Blocks$()
$(l)Middle Layer:$() one $(item)Polymetal Block$() at each corner
$(l)Top Layer:$() one $(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$() at center
$(9)Right-click$() the $(item)Heavy Grudge Lump$() to activate the Vortex.

Deposit at least $(c)100$() of each of the four construction resources, and ensure sufficient $(6)lava$() as energy.
Click the $(4)spawn egg icon$() on the right side to start building.
$(9)Double-click$() the same icon to enter $(c)Continuous Build Mode$(). The Vortex will remember the current resource allocation and repeat the same construction.
Use the $(4)red arrows$() to withdraw excess resources.

Before building the Vortex, you first need the $(9)Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent$() as a foundation.
The Vent is the simplified version of the Vortex, used for $(c)standard ship construction$() and $(c)equipment development$().

Deposit materials in the Vortex GUI, then click the $(c)equipment icon$() to start equipment development.
Equipment development consumes the same resource types (construction materials + lava) as ship construction, though the ratios differ.
Both the Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex and the Abyssal Hydrothermal Vent can be used for equipment development.

Placing $(d)$(n)Instant Construction Materials$()$() into the Vortex's fuel slot will $(c)instantly increase construction progress$().
Instant Construction Materials can only be crafted from unused ship spawn eggs.
$(c)Enchant Shells$() are also crafted here — make a base shell in the Vortex, then combine it with potions at a crafting table to apply potion effects.

The $(item)Abyssal Volcano Core$() is an energy-type multiblock component that pairs well with the Vortex.
The Core passively absorbs ambient Grudge energy and releases it as restorative energy. Ships standing nearby can absorb this energy to quickly recover morale.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.shipyard_tools: The $(item)Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex$() is the large-scale shipyard. Use it for high-tier ship construction and bulk resource handling.
The $(item)Kaitai Hammer$() recycles ship spawn eggs into $(item)Instant Construction Material$(), preserving the old progression loop of converting unused eggs into build accelerators.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.equipment_supp: $(item)Abyssal Armor$() provides damage reduction and durability for the equipped ship. Higher-tier armor variants offer better protection at the cost of weight and speed modifiers.
$(item)Abyssal Catapult Type F MkII$() boosts aircraft launch capacity and reload speed. Essential for carriers and aviation battleships that rely on sustained air operations.
The $(item)Abyssal Compass$() provides navigation-related utility and minor hit/critical rate support for fleet operations.
$(item)Abyssal Flare$() illuminates targets and provides passive utility such as target highlighting during night operations.
The $(item)Abyssal Searchlight$() restores old passive utility behavior, including target illumination and self-lighting for the equipped ship.
$(item)Abyssal Boiler$() (Turbine equipment) improves ship mobility and speed. It is especially useful on slower ship classes that need positioning advantages in formation combat.

patchouli.shincolle.entry.misc_items.pag: This chapter covers several special items that do not fit into regular categories. Each serves a unique purpose: transferring ship ownership, rapidly leveling ships, and crafting enchanted ammunition in the Hadal Vortex.

The $(item)Ownership Paper$() is a formal contract detailing the rights and obligations of both parties in a ship transfer. Once signed by both parties, the original owner can $(9)right-click$() the target ship to complete the transfer.

The $(item)Training Manual$() is a concentrated guide to abyssal logistics. $(9)Right-click$() it on a tamed, owned ship to directly increase its level. These books can be found in dungeon chests and are the fastest way to skip early slow growth.

$(item)Enchanted Ammo$() is a special branch of ammunition imbued with magical effects. It can be crafted in the $(c)Hadal Hydrothermal Vortex$(). Combine the base ammo with eight bottles of the same potion to apply the corresponding effect. Further upgrades with eight more potions increase the trigger rate and duration.
patchouli.shincolle.entry.enchantment_re: When enchanting ship equipment on an anvil, you need 30 levels of experience. Different vanilla Minecraft enchantments map to different ship combat stats. Equipment is classified into three types: $(c)Weapon$() (WPN), $(9)Armor$() (ARM), and $(3)Other$() (OTH). The following table shows the current mapping.

$(9)Protection$() → Durability$(br)$(9)Sharpness etc.$() → Damage$(c) (WPN)$(br)$(9)Unbreaking$() → Defense$(9) (ARM)$(br)$(9)Efficiency$() → Reload Speed$(br)$(9)Aqua Affinity / Feather Falling / Respiration$() → Weight Reduction
$(9)Knockback$() → Range$(br)$(9)Frost Walker$() → Crit Rate$(br)$(9)Fire Aspect / Flame$() → Multi-hit Rate$(br)$(9)Lure$() → Error Rate Reduction$(br)$(9)Thorns$() → Anti-Air

patchouli.shincolle.entry.furniture.page: An admiral's base needs more than just functional machines. Decorative furniture blocks add atmosphere to your port. While they do not directly participate in combat or production, they give your abyssal stronghold a unique character.

The $(item)Abyssal Admiral's Chair$() is crafted from精选 abyssal materials and residual grudges. Its comfort is so remarkable that you will not want to get up, and even cannon impacts are comfortably absorbed. Both the admiral and ship girls can sit on it.

When lava is compressed by intense grudges, it forms the high-temperature, high-pressure $(item)Abyssal Volcano Block$(). This is a purely decorative building block, perfect for creating volcano-themed base structures.
The $(item)Abyssal Scaffold$() is a decorative building block twisted by deep-sea pressure. It can also be used as a ladder, providing practical vertical mobility for your port.
